description: This file defines the PricingService interface, which specifies methods for calculating product prices, considering various factors such as customer details, product attributes, and currency. It also includes methods for formatting monetary amounts for display.

classes.name: PricingService
classes.description: An interface providing methods to calculate product pricing with various levels of detail and context, as well as methods for formatting amounts for display.

methods.name: calculateProductPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final price of a product, optionally considering customer details or product attributes.

methods.name: getDisplayAmount
methods.description: Formats a monetary amount into a display string considering the store's formatting rules.

methods.name: getStringAmount
methods.description: Provides a string representation of a monetary amount without currency symbol.
